title: Prove shared-report recipient preview and recipient data-scope with nonempty isolated SQL data
description: Stage-1 genuine database validation gap. Sharing persistence (grant/revoke/pin) is SQL-tested but the recipient read path (ReportConfigurationExecutionService.PreviewSharedAsync -> pinned revision) is never driven with nonempty data on real SQL, so pinned-revision fidelity and recipient (not owner) data-scope are unproven. Implement a self-contained fixture with an owner, a second activated recipient with restricted salesperson data scope, customers and non-deleted sales orders on the dedicated isolated localdb, publish a revision, grant it, then preview as the recipient and assert only the pinned snapshot rows and only the recipient's allowed customers are returned; revocation converges to fail-closed. No production data, arbitrary SQL, secrets/.env changes, permission expansion or schema change; no SeedData*.cs / SchemaUpgrader.cs edits.
acceptance_criteria: A self-contained fixture seeds an owner, a second activated recipient with restricted salesperson data scope, customers and non-deleted sales orders on the dedicated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance / NEWERP_AUTOTEST-prefixed database with target identity asserted before writes; process-only connection settings, idempotent, never touching SeedData*.cs or SchemaUpgrader.cs.

Recipient preview resolves the fixed published revision (ignoring client RevisionVersion and never exposing draft/other revisions), returns the pinned nonempty rows, and applies the recipient's (not owner's) salesperson data scope; owner-only grant/revoke concurrency semantics are preserved.

After revocation the recipient preview fails closed (as not found) and no stale rows leak; run focused SQL tests, safe Release build/test and scheduler self-test/contracts. Do not claim full stage-1 or real-browser acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationExecutionService.cs:180-181 and PreviewSharedAsync (lines ~300-329) resolve the shared pinned revision and re-apply recipient identity, but no real-SQL test drives it with nonempty data or a scoped recipient; .ai/logs/stage1-followup-planning-20261004T0847.json records 'permissions, sharing and browser remain unverified'; .ai/logs/report-platform-browser-acceptance-20261004T1000.json 'limitation' records zero-row smoke does not prove data-scope.
